verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap runs a first-party hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants transcribe audio and video inside conversations. It also exposes tools such as cancel_job and check_access and ships 'transcribe' and 'subtitles' prompt templates, and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and OAuth-gated. Natural-language operation still depends on an external AI client interpreting the user's commands, and the product has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command surface, a fully documented tool list covering job creation and result retrieval, and independent hands-on evidence of conversational operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Speech is Cheap Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets AI assistants transcribe audio and video files directly within your conversations.
an MCP server lets AI assistants transcribe
